lede: The day's one point of agreement across feeds was a breach: hackers claiming they hold data on every FBI employee, live on both Hacker News and Lemmy at the same time. Hacker News itself read like a model-launch board, with Claude Opus 5.5 near the top at 1,368 points and OpenAI's GPT-6 close behind. Wikipedia's crowd went the other way, pushing Lizzie Borden to 679,382 views, the day's most-read article, on the back of Netflix's new Monster season.
